what: A cylindrical band made of six photos joined as curved pieces is tilted 15° on X and 8° on Z and slowly makes one turn every 40s (three.js) — the near side shows the photos, the far side shows the card backs (gray). The camera pulls back so that card height × 1.15 is 44% of the panel height and looks toward −35% of the panel half-width, so the band sits off to the right. At widths of 575·767·1024 and below it scales to .75·.85·.9x
note: three: load three.cjs(r152) as a plain script after three-global.js <script> Loaded via a script tag (the old three.min.js warns from r150). With the module build, attach it to window.THREE and fire three:ready, and it hooks in at that point

options.fill: Share of the board height taken by card height × 1.15, default .44
options.bias: Shifts the gaze sideways by this multiple of the panel’s half-width, default -.35 (band moves right)
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: One card (child) — if img, that photo, otherwise a placeholder panel with data-label (skin color)

use: …(six sections)

from.where: index.html .jf-ring (Hero 100vh — original three r152 · card 350×220 · 15°/8° · 40s · gap 1.2 · fill .44 · bias -.35)
